jobs.title: Football Tracking Technician (North)
jobs.description:
Location:  We are currently hiring across key Northern regions and North East coastal hubs. Ideal candidates will be within easy commuting distance of partner EPL and EFL stadiums across these target areas.

Contract Type:  Casual hourly contract – Setup Day & Match Day
 Hourly Rate :  £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour. Rates vary depending on role

Role Overview:

As a  Football Tracking Technician , you will work  on-site  at football stadiums across your region, playing a vital role in the delivery of Hawk-Eye’s tracking and officiating technologies for  Premier League ,  EFL , and  UEFA  fixtures.  You will be responsible for the  setup ,  calibration , and  optimisation  of services including  Goal Line Technology  (GLT) and  Electronic Performance & Tracking Systems  (EPTS). This includes  connecting  and  configuring PCs and hardware  within stadium  fibre-optic networks ,  optimising camera alignments,

troubleshooting technical issues  in real time, and  coordinating  closely with remote operations centres, on-site technical leads, and replay operators to ensure seamless match delivery.  Comprehensive technical training and ongoing support will be provided, giving you full exposure to industry-leading sports technology systems and live match operations.  This is an exciting opportunity to gain  hands-on experience  in elite football environments, live broadcast technology, and high-performance sports operations at the highest level of the game.  This role is ideal for individuals looking to gain practical, hands-on experience in sports technology while maintaining a  flexible routine . Because live matchday operations follow the football fixture calendar - predominantly concentrated on  weekends  with  occasional midweek commitments  for training and fixtures - we are seeking candidates with  strong availability  to cover these key operational windows.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Stadium Setup:  Rigging Hawk-Eye technology at the stadium.  Please note: This involves physically demanding work, including running heavy cables, rigging cameras, and working at height.

System Calibration:  Conducting pre-match setup, hardware checks, and technical calibration of tracking systems in accordance with standard operational procedures.

Live Match Monitoring:  Actively monitoring hardware and software performance during live matches to instantly troubleshoot, resolve, and report technical errors.

Stakeholder Management:  Liaising professionally with stadium staff, match officials, and host broadcasters on-site, serving as a trusted brand ambassador for Hawk-Eye

Why Is This The Right Job For You?

We’re looking for individuals who are  reliable, professional, and passionate about football . This position is perfect for you if you possess:

Strong  problem-solving  skills

Excellent  communication and teamwork  abilities

A  passion  for  innovation

A  willingness to learn

The ability to thrive in a  fast-paced and pressurised environment

Flexible schedule

jobs.description:

We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

Among the  fastest-growing tech  companies in the UK

Profitable since  2017

Backed by top investors including  Balderton Capital  and  Goldman Sachs

Loved by customers  with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on

Trustpilot  )

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch:  loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks  with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership  across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

Work in small teams of exceptional people,  who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

Build the best technology in-house , using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re looking for  a super smart graduate who is great with numbers  and  loves problem solving  to come and  apply your skills in a start up environment  and have a  big impact  on our business and how we do things.

What you'll be doing

Use your  analytical and problem-solving skills to generate key insights from data,  and use that insight to drive meaningful change in our strategy

Using  data and modelling to ground assumptions for our NPV model,  such as predicting what default rates will be in the future, and using that to inform our lending deicsions

Using data and analytics to

drive decisions  about who we should lend to, and how much we should lend to them, and how that changes with the economy and competition changes

Conducting hypothesis testing, and using your findings to change how we do things in areas such as lending strategy, pricing, and fraud detection

Presenting your findings to senior leaders  in the company, then work with the product/tech team to get them implemented

A graduate with a degree

Someone that loves numbers ! You’ll be working with numbers every single day in this role so you’ll be able to demonstrate your ability to work with complex data sets, analyse them and draw insights

You’ll have a  natural curiosity and love to dig into things to understand how they work

Startup mindset . We’re a fast-growth tech startup so you’ll be super excited to work in an entrepreneurial environment and have a real impact on the business

Interview Process

15-minute online test

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead - EMEA
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.

We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.

As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta:

Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region

Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights

Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives

Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral

Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market

Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success

Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.  We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.  We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.  If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas.

Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

What We're Looking For

Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

Can set direction and still go deep into details.

Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

Experience with Redis or similar for session/cache management

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as  YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch,

Portage , and more, known for backing leading companies such as  Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox , and most recently was awarded a place in the  UK’s top 100 startups for 2026 .

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable  — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

Writing the commentary  that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

Producing the monthly investor reporting pack  and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

Owning the full revenue cycle  — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

Leading the rollout of automated billing  and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

Managing our two legal entities  — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

Owning the compliance calendar end to end  across both jurisdictions

About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.  You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.  We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

Job Description  We protect our customers’ digital infrastructure, keeping it secure, fast, and online, even under active attack. As a cybersecurity provider, we run high-performance systems in a genuinely hostile environment, where code quality, security, and rigorous input validation are not hygiene: they are the product. Our customers trust us with business-critical traffic, and we build and operate to the highest standards of certification for critical infrastructure.

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d), you will help your team design and build robust solutions for complex problems. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, who starts from the problem, reasons about the trade-offs of the environment it will run in, and reaches for the tool that fits, rather than the one on their CV. We are constantly improving our applications and we work AI-natively: AI coding agents are part of how we spec, build, and review every day. We strongly believe in “you build it, you run it, you own it” and a “collaboration culture”, where you and the team are on the frontlines and driving the change together!

Own features end-to-end, from backend service design through to the frontend slice the feature needs, in an international, cross-functional team of software engineers, QA and OPS professionals  Design, validate and advocate architecture decisions for your team’s verticals, with a bias toward well-structured, service-oriented backends  Work AI-natively: use AI coding agents as core tooling to move faster and raise quality, while staying fully accountable for the code you ship  Drive technical discussions and decisions with your team  Push toward continuous delivery, improving both the software and how we build it  Write code that performs, and holds up in production under hostile, high-volume traffic, with security and input validation built in from the start

Your Qualifications

You think in systems.  You start from the problem and the constraints, not from a favorite language. To you the difference between languages is largely syntax; what actually matters is the environment code runs in: performance, portability, compatibility, operational cost, and long-term maintenance

You can explain your choices.  You can walk us through a time you chose one language or runtime over another, and the trade-offs that drove the decision, and you can do the same for the frontend when a feature calls for it

You’ve gone deep, not just broad.  At least 5 years of intensive, hands-on coding and engineering experience — this is a senior role and not a fit for juniors — with genuine depth in at least one or two ecosystems. Our stack today is mostly PHP / Symfony, React and GraphQL; Edge systems use C, Rust and Python mostly.

We care a lot about experience with Python, Go, C and/or Rust.  These are parts that are being introduced to our dev department and where a significant part of our edge logic is based in, and someone who already reasons

You own both the relationship and the code.  This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Embed with a first customer, learn their workflow, and define the real problem.

Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Build and deploy a production system they actually use.

Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Spot the pattern worth productizing and work with R&D to turn it into platform.

What You Bring

2+ years of professional software engineering, with software shipped end to end.

Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar).

Ability to work across the stack and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

Nice to Have

A track record of shipping real systems with real users, not just assigned tasks.

High agency and strong prioritization: you find the core problem and move.

Comfort defining your own path when there isn't one.

Evidence of working directly with customers and translating what you heard into what you built.

Clear communication, including explaining a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder.

Full product availability. Zero food waste. Build the supply chain that delivers both.

KoRo is a better-for-you food brand on a fast track from a D2C-born challenger to a European omnichannel love brand – and increasingly a serious player on the retail shelf. jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week,  a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit  www.perk.com  to learn more.

About the Role

We are hiring our  first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering .

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the  VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue System

Mission  Unser Vertriebsteam wächst — mit einem neuen Head of Sales an Bord suchen wir eine:n Account Executive, der/die Bauträger:innen und Immobilienentwickler:innen nicht nur von yoursquares überzeugt, sondern als zentrale Ansprechperson auf Augenhöhe echte, langfristige Partnerschaften aufbaut. Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales-Zyklus ab dem ersten qualifizierten Termin bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag — von der Bedarfsanalyse bei Bauträgern und Immobilienentwicklern bis zum Abschluss, ganz ohne Mikromanagement.  Du übernimmst vorqualifizierte Leads aus unserer SDR- und Marketing-Pipeline (HubSpot) und baust dir daraus deine eigene, belastbare Opportunity-Pipeline auf.  Du führst Produktdemos und Verhandlungen eigenständig, passt Angebote auf Unternehmensgröße und Entscheidungsstruktur an und schließt Deals eigenverantwortlich ab.  Du dokumentierst jeden Schritt sauber in HubSpot, damit Forecast und Pipeline-Reporting jederzeit belastbar sind — Transparenz ist Teil der Leistung, keine Nebensache.  Du bringst laufend Verbesserungsvorschläge für unseren Sales-Prozess ein und schärfst Playbooks und Objection-Handling für das wachsende Team mit.  Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success zusammen, damit aus jedem Abschluss ein zufriedener, langfristiger Kunde wird.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales, idealerweise im Software-/SaaS-Vertrieb an Bauträger, Immobilienentwickler oder eine vergleichbar erklärungsbedürftige Zielgruppe  Nachweisbare Abschlussstärke: konkrete Abschlussquoten oder Umsatzzahlen aus deiner bisherigen Rolle  Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise HubSpot, sowie Grundverständnis für KI-gestützte Vorqualifizierung und Automatisierung in der Pipeline  Verhandlungssichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch, souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Entscheider:innen auf Geschäftsführungsebene  Hohe Eigenmotivation und Frustrationstoleranz auch bei längeren B2B-Sales-Zyklen

Du Leads lieber horten statt Informationen mit SDRs und Marketing zu teilen  — unsere Pipeline funktioniert nur, wenn jede Rolle offen mit der nächsten zusammenarbeitet.

Dir Status und Ellenbogen wichtiger sind als das gemeinsame Ergebnis  — Silodenken und Ego-Spiele bremsen genau das Tempo, das uns wachsen lässt.

Was wir dir bieten:

Kein Arbeitstag bei yoursquares gleicht dem anderen – zwischen Vertragsabschlüssen, Kunden-Calls und spontanen Team-Sessions entsteht ständig Bewegung. jobs.title: Staff/Senior AI Engineer, AI for Code
jobs.description:
At JetBrains, we build developer tools used by millions of engineers. The AI for Code team works on the next generation of coding agents and agentic workflows: systems that can understand codebases, plan and execute multi-step tasks, collaborate with developers, and ship reliable results inside real development environments.

We are looking for a Staff/Senior AI Engineer to join the team and support these efforts. This role is for someone who can take our internal coding models, such as Mellum2, as well as open-weight models, and turn them into production-ready coding agents for our users. You’ll work on model training and fine-tuning, context engineering, tool use, evaluation, feedback loops, and product integration. This is not research in isolation – you’ll build systems that are used by tens of thousands of developers.

What you’ll do:

  • Build production-ready coding agents and agentic workflows for real developer tasks inside JetBrains products.
  • Turn promising model capabilities into dependable product behavior through prompt design, context construction, fine-tuning, instruction-tuning, or other post-training techniques where appropriate.
  • Design and improve the agent loop itself, including tool use, execution strategy, safeguards, and task completion quality.
  • Create evaluation suites and quality infrastructure for agent behavior, including online and offline evaluations, regression checks, failure analysis, and release criteria.
  • Build feedback loops from real usage, using logs, user signals, and edge cases to improve data, evaluations, and agent behavior.
  • Work with both hosted frontier APIs and self-hosted or open-weight models, making pragmatic decisions about where each model belongs based on capability, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, ML engineers, and researchers to ship features end to end.
  • Help define the technical direction for future work, especially in ambiguous areas where we need strong judgment rather than a prewritten playbook.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping complex systems to production.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered products, coding agents, or other AI systems.
  • Experience improving model behavior through systematic iteration, whether via prompting, context engineering, fine-tuning, preference optimization, or broader post-training methods.
  • Practical experience with evaluation and benchmarking for LLM systems, including defining task-grounded success metrics and catching regressions.
  • Experience working from noisy real-world signals rather than only from clean benchmark datasets.
  • Good judgment about trade-offs between model quality, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost.

jobs.title: Staff Robotics Software Engineer - Grasping
jobs.description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Staff Robotics Software Engineer and Researcher, you will take full technical ownership of developing and deploying robotics grasping and manipulation algorithms, leading the end-to-end lifecycle from foundational research to global deployment. You will help define the architecture and long-term strategy that enables robots to interact with the physical world, researching and scoping innovative solutions for robust grasping in industrial settings. By abstracting the inherent complexity of robotic manipulation into intuitive workflows, you will work with a multidisciplinary team to integrate and validate high-availability software within complex, real-world industrial applications for manufacturing environments.

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Design and implement robust and efficient production-ready algorithms for robotic grasping and manipulation.
  • Identify opportunities to apply cutting-edge advancements in robotics and apply them to practical industrial problems
  • Transform complex partner requirements into highly reliable and functional technical outcomes.
  • Mentor junior engineers, contribute to the strategic roadmap and drive the evolution of our robotic software stack for global industrial deployment.

Skills you will need to be successful

  • Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, with 8+ years of experience in robotics.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in robotic grasp planning.
  • 2 years of leading substantial, ambiguous technical projects from inception to deployment
  • Strong foundational knowledge in linear algebra, spatial transformations, and rigid body dynamics.
  • 6 years of professional experience programming robotics software in C++ and Python, with a proven track record of shipping production-quality code.
  • Experience Machine Learning in applied robotics context

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

  • PhD in Robotics and Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, or a related field with a focus on robotic manipulation, grasp planning, or motion planning.
  • ML Frameworks: Deep expertise with JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.<

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on

Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100

, made

Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026

(Top 25 in Finance), and landed on

The Sunday Times Best Places to Work

two years running.

About MoonPay Enterprise

MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

KYB product strategy & roadmap

Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Acquisition - Munich, Germany
jobs.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You'll Do

Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline

Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.

Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.

Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.

5+ years of industry experience in software development.

Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments

Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)

Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus

Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.

An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.

A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.

An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.

Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.

Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.

Build products that directly impact and support people

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Windows/Desktop Applications - Stuttgart, Germany

Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.

Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.

Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.

Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.

An ideal candidate should have

Required:

3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).

Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.

Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.

Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

Cross-Platform Mastery:  Continually develop technical expertise across all Strategic Lightspe

The Member Experience Training & Quality Coordinator makes the Neko member experience standard real on the ground. You will facilitate training that shifts mindset, not just process, run experience audits against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, and turn what you see into coaching and improvement. You report to the Hospitality Programme Lead and support the wider rollout, so you will also play a hands-on part in projects and launch activity as new clinics and teams come online.

Stage 1 and Stage 2 member experience training delivered consistently to every new clinic cohort in your market, with 30-day reviews showing the mindset shift is landing, not just attendance being logged.  (Member First, always)

A regular quality assurance rhythm is live: experience audits across clinic and support teams, scored consistently against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, with clear findings shared back to the teams and their leads.  (Impact, not activity)

Audit insight turned into action: recurring friction points named early and at least two concrete experience improvements implemented with clinic and support leads.  (Optimistic truth-seeking)

Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.

jobs.location: London, UK; Ontario, CAN; Remote-Friendly, United States; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Apply using this link. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Access to a shared workspace (in either Berkeley, California or London, UK)
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, technical assessments & interviews, and a research discussion.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per w

About Anthropic

About the role

Our Inference team is responsible for building and maintaining the critical systems that serve Claude to millions of users worldwide. We bring Claude to life by serving our models via the industry’s largest compute-agnostic inference deployments. We are responsible for the entire stack from intelligent request routing to fleet-wide orchestration across diverse AI accelerators.

The team has a dual mandate: maximizing compute efficiency to reliably serve our explosive customer growth, while enabling breakthrough research by giving our scientists the high-performance inference infrastructure they need to develop next-generation models. We tackle complex, distributed systems challenges across multiple accelerator families and emerging AI hardware running in multiple cloud platforms.

Inference systems are highly performance sensitive distributed systems. Inference serves hundreds of thousands of customers every day, and the size & span of the inference fleet requires sophisticated routing, scaling, and networking systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain the distributed systems that serve Claude to millions of users worldwide

  • Develop resilient, flexible systems that adapt in real time to real world events

  • Develop intelligent request routing, load balancing, and traffic management systems across thousands of accelerators

  • Maximize compute efficiency across the fleet by autoscaling and orchestrating production, research, and experimental workloads

  • Build and operate production-grade deployment pipelines for releasing new models to users

  • Provide high-performance inference infrastructure that enables researchers to develop next-generation models

  • Integrate new AI accelerator platforms and support inference for new model architectures

Minimum qualifications

  • Significant software engineering experience, particularly with distributed systems

  • Results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact

  • Willingness to pick up slack, even if it goes outside your job description

  • Desire to learn more about machine learning systems and infrastructure

  • Thrive in environments where technical excellence directly drives both business results and research breakthroughs

  • Care about the societal impacts of your work

Anthropic’s commercial business is scaling at a pace that outruns any fixed go-to-market plan. New products and capabilities launch on a frontier cadence, new GTM motions get incubated and reorganized in months rather than years, and for each thing we sell, the questions of who we sell it to, how the field and our partners execute, how we win against the alternatives, and whether it’s working have to be answered continuously and globally. We need a leader who owns those answers.

You’ll lead the Sales Strategy team inside our Central GTM Strategy, Operations & Analytics organization, with a global scope across our full solution portfolio. That breaks into three things.

You’ll design the sales strategy for our solution portfolio from defining the core sales motions, who we target with them - across personas, segments, industries, and geographies - how we execute, including how the field and channel are orchestrated and which sales assets and programs support them; how we respond to competitor moves, and how we measure progress, through the KPIs and OKRs the business is run against.

You’ll be the connective tissue across Product, Marketing, Finance, Sales, Regional Sales Strategy, Customer Success, Enablement, and Operations, so that every GTM lever is tuned to drive execution success at scale rather than each function optimizing its own piece. Where a product, segment, or region is pacing behind its aspiration, you’ll co-own the plan to close the gap with the sales strategy partners for that part of the business, and stay with it until it does.

And you’ll own the signal. jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

jobs.title: Head of Policy Design, Societal Harms
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Safeguards organization builds the policies, evaluations, and detection and enforcement systems that define and hold the limits on how Claude can be used. In this role, you'll lead our policy design team, managing the teams responsible for radicalization, child safety, user well-being, harmful manipulation, and election integrity, among other harm areas.

The team is responsible for understanding and defining the risks that come with engaging with Claude, how those risks materialize in the real world, and the mitigations needed to prevent them. As the manager, you'll work with your team to draw the boundaries between what is and is not allowed, then partner with research, product, and engineering to build the right interventions. Mitigating these harms takes the whole stack: the values and judgment trained into the model itself, the policies and detection systems we enforce on top of it, and the interventions we build into our products. More capable models, new product surfaces, and new user behaviors will keep testing these boundaries, so the team's policies have to keep pace.

You'll work closely with product to develop and iterate on the strategy and vision for how our safety layers fit together, and with your team and cross-functional partners to decide which mitigations make the most sense and how to implement them. You'll also coordinate policy decisions across the portfolio: ensuring they're made with the right stakeholders in the room, tracked over time, and applied consistently across harm areas and product surfaces.

This is a leadership role for someone who combines expertise in the harm areas themselves with fluency in how frontier models are actually developed and deployed, and who does their best work across team boundaries. You'll spend as much time developing the leads who own each harm area as you will on the policy questions themselves.

*Important context for this role: some of the work involves exposure to explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead, develop, and grow the managers and teams responsible for the consumer harms portfolio, including child safety, user well-being, harmful manipulation, and election integrity

  • Coordinate policy decisions across the portfolio, and build the mechanisms that keep them tracked, consistent, and legible — so stakeholders know what was decided, why, and who owns what

Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era.  Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is  to  free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where  more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
 •  ~110 people , more than  half  in engineering, product and data

The Opportunity

You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft.  You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

jobs.description:
Stora is looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of the sales function as the business moves into its next stage of growth.  This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-the-sidelines one.  There is already a product customers want, an established position in the UK and Ireland, growing European opportunity, and a sales team in place. The challenge now is to turn that foundation into a more predictable, repeatable commercial engine.  You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit.

Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before.  The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like:

Where should the team focus its time and why?

How does outbound become consistently productive?

Where are deals getting stuck?

How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed?

Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities?

What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally?

How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on?

This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results.

Sales strategy and execution

Leadership, coaching and development of the SDR and AE team

Outbound performance and pipeline generation

Sales process from first engagement through to closed-won

Forecasting, pipeline health and revenue visibility

Performance management and clear expectations across the team

Key and strategically important opportunities where senior involvement can make a difference

Close alignment with Marketing and Product around ICP, messaging, customer insight and market opportunity

Stora needs a hands-on B2B SaaS sales leader who can build consistent performance, not just manage what already exists.

You’re likely someone who:

Has a genuine hunter mentality and knows how to create pipeline, not just manage what lands

Has led and developed SaaS sales teams and can raise the standard of performance around them

Knows what good outbound looks like and can coach it properly

Has personally sold into SMB and/or mid-market customers and can still step into important deals when needed

Builds healthier, more predictable pipeline and brings strong forecasting discipline

Qualifies hard, prioritises well and is comfortable walking away from weak opportunities

jobs.title: Corporate Finance & Strategy, Cash Flow Forecasting
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our Corporate Finance & Strategy team serves as a strategic partner to Anthropic's leadership, driving data-informed decisions that shape our company's future. We are seeking a professional for our Corporate Finance team to support Anthropic's financial planning and reporting capabilities. In this role, you will build and own Anthropic's balance sheet and cash flow forecast, providing leadership a reliable, driver-based view of free cash flow and liquidity.

You’ll own and scale Anthropic's balance sheet and cash flow forecast, taking what exists today and building it into a rigorous, driver-based model. You'll design its architecture and define a robust forecasting methodology and cadence that can scale with the complexity of the business. You'll partner closely with Finance & Strategy, Accounting, and Treasury to turn the forecast into a shared view of cash and liquidity that informs capital and investment decisions. This role offers a unique opportunity to build foundational financial reporting and forecasting processes at Anthropic, using Claude to define what workflows look like when AI is a core part of the toolkit.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the balance sheet and cash flow forecast: design the model architecture, choose the tooling, and develop forecasting methodologies for cash-impacting items including working capital, capex, leases, debt and interest, equity and stock-based compensation, and cash taxes
  • Partner with Finance & Strategy on the forecast inputs and hand-offs the model depends on, with Accounting to ensure the forecast maps to and reconciles with reported financials, and with Treasury to align the cash flow forecast with their direct cash view
  • Deliver free cash flow reporting, a driver-based cash bridge, and scenarios and sensitivities on cash and liquidity that inform capital and investment decisions
  • Integrate the balance sheet and cash flow into the forecast calendar and reporting package, and raise the bar over time by automating actuals loads, tie-outs, and process rigor

Minimum qualifications

  • Have designed and built an integrated three-statement forecast, not just maintained one
  • Have partnered closely with Accounting and Treasury to align forecasts with the close and cash processes
  • Are highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets, with expertise in modern financial planning tools (e.g., Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive)
  • Demonstrate excellent communication and storytelling abilities

jobs.title: Director, Product Management (Social & Player Identity Platform)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

What You'll Do

As a Director of Product Management (Social & Player Identity Platform), you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Epic’s social and identity ecosystem across mobile, PC, and console. You will lead efforts to create seamless, connected player experiences, ensuring players can easily establish their identity, maintain continuity across devices, and meaningfully connect with others.

In this role, you will apply both creative and analytical thinking to evolve foundational platform systems - including accounts, identity, and social features – while partnering across teams to improve engagement, retention, and ecosystem connectivity at scale.

In this role, you will

  • Drive the social and identity platform strategy, contributing to a unified roadmap that strengthens player connection, engagement, and long-term retention across the ecosystem
  • Own core player systems, including identity (accounts, authentication, profiles), social graph (friends, presence, communication), and cross-platform continuity, ensuring seamless and consistent experiences across all surfaces
  • Partner with development and design teams to identify and prioritize platform-level features and system improvements that enhance how players discover, connect, and interact with others
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners (game teams, publishing, marketing, regional teams) to integrate social and identity systems into player journeys, optimizing onboarding, engagement loops, and social-driven growth
  • Work closely with engineering teams to deliver scalable, high-performance backend and frontend systems that support identity and social features across millions of players globally
  • Leverage data and experimentation to define success metrics, evaluate feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve adoption, engagement

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - MONOPOLY GO!
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join our MONOPOLY GO! team in our Culver City studio hub on a hybrid basis, or remotely within the US.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

As a Senior Product Analyst you will join a team of Product Analysts and Analytical Engineers, working to support the Minigame Vertical team in collaboration with the wider analytics org. In this role, partnering with our internal data platform and data science teams, you will use data to generate player behavior insights and improve feature performance; from data modeling and event tracking, through to AB-testing, insightful analyses and recommendations that answer the game’s most complex and challenging questions. This is an individual contributor role, that has a lot of independence and responsibility, with building processes and taking end to end analytics projects

  • Data Analysis: Dive deep into large, complex data sets to extract actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making. Analyze player behavior, game performance, and trends to inform product strategies and optimizations
  • Game Team Support: Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities and challenges to the specific game vertical. Define key metrics, establish data collection processes, implement analytical frameworks and effectively communicate the insights to drive continuous improvement
  • Ownership of Analysis: Take ownership of end-to-end analytical projects, from the inception of a new feature to ensure robust reporting and monitoring is in place, to design and assess A/B experimentation and deliver final insights, interpretations and presentations
  • Drive the execution of analytical initiatives with precision and attention to detail

  • Product Roadmap Influence: Partner to shape the future direction of the game

Leverage data-driven insights to prioritize features, optimize game economies, and refine product roadmaps for maximum player engagement and satisfaction

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Why Safety?

At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world.

Why Safety Foundation?

Safety Foundation is the infrastructure backbone that powers safety across Roblox. Every piece of content reviewed, every moderation action taken, every safety workflow running anywhere on the platform flows through systems built by this team. We are the platform that other safety teams build on — and right now, we're in the middle of one of the most significant evolutions in our history.

We're scaling to handle 10x more traffic while keeping cost growth in check. We're rebuilding the platform to be AI-first, natively supporting agentic and ML-driven safety workflows without compromising on security or auditability. And we're radically improving developer velocity — cutting the time it takes any team to integrate safety capabilities from months to hours.

As a Principal Software Engineer on Safety Foundation, you'll be the hands-on tech lead for a group of engineers on the team. You'll set technical direction, own architecture decisions, and stay deeply engaged in the work

As a Principal Software Engineer on the Engine DataModel team, you will own and innovate on the foundational components that form the backbone of the Roblox platform. In the Roblox Engine, the DataModel is a tree-like structure that is analogous to a scenegraph in other 3D engines. This role will report to the engineering manager and will be based out of our HQ in San Mateo, CA in a hybrid model 3 days a week (Tuesdays to Thursdays).

Our team owns:

  • The core structures and systems are used to build the DataModel and interact with it.
  • The C++ reflection bindings that form the Engine’s Luau API surface and let creators interact with the DataModel. We’ve built custom codegen tooling to generate the C++ for these reflection bindings and other related structures.
  • DataModel serialization … and much more!

You will:

  • Develop engine code that performs well for all user-created games on the Roblox platform.
  • Build the core systems and data structures used in the Roblox engine, working with other teams to find universal solutions.
  • Take ownership of projects throughout their full lifecycles.
  • Execute code that performs well on all the devices Roblox supports—from desktop clients to mobile phone clients to console clients.

You have:

  • Experience developing outstanding systems-level C++ programming.
  • Have experience working on game engine internals
  • Responsibility for building and maintaining systems that work optimally.
  • Curiosity to learn and stay up-to-date on technology developments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?

What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?

How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from  acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation .

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.

Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.

Build and maintain dashboards and reporting

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Business Systems Analyst on Anthropic's BizTech team, you'll play a crucial role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You'll translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and architectural decisions, ensuring engineering teams build solutions that scale with our rapid growth. You'll work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand their requirements, configure systems, and ensure our business technology ecosystem operates efficiently and effectively. This role combines analytical thinking with technical expertise to design, implement, and maintain systems that drive operational excellence.

You'll be responsible for analyzing business processes, gathering requirements, and translating them into technical solutions. As we continue to scale rapidly, you'll help ensure our systems and processes evolve to meet the growing demands of our organization while maintaining the high standards of efficiency and reliability that Anthropic requires.

Responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end delivery of technical projects from conception through launch
  • Configure and customize business systems to meet specific organizational needs, including user permissions, workflows, and integrations
  • Manage technical vendor evaluation for business applications, including contract negotiations, service level agreements, and ongoing vendor performance assessment
  • Create and maintain comprehensive system documentation, including process flows, user guides, configuration specifications, and technical documentation
  • Lead knowledge management initiatives to ensure institutional knowledge is captured, organized, and accessible to all team members
  • Own technical risk assessment and mitigation strategies
  • Analyze current business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization
  • Act as a liaison between technical teams and business users, translating complex technical concepts into user-friendly language
  • Conduct system testing, validation, and user acceptance testing for new implementations and updates
  • Provide ongoing support and training to end-users across the organization
  • Monitor system performance and usage metrics to identify areas for improvement
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure business systems integrate seamlessly with other platforms
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry

Anthropic is hiring an EHS Specialist to lead Environment, Health and Safety across our EMEA region. As Anthropic continues to scale globally — with a fast-growing footprint across the UK, Ireland, and continental Europe — we're investing in EHS expertise on the ground, where the work happens.
