jobs.title: Head of Deal Desk - International
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Deal Desk sits at the center of how we turn commercial intent into signed, bookable business. As demand for Claude grows across every region, the deals themselves are getting larger, more structured, and more consequential — and the desk is what keeps them moving quickly without sacrificing pricing discipline, deal quality, or clean handoffs downstream. We already run this well in the Americas. This role builds and leads the equivalent outside it.

You'll own Deal Desk for our international business — EMEA and APAC — and lead a team of three. You'll be the commercial partner sales teams come to when a deal doesn't fit the standard shape: multi-year and consumption structures, non-standard pricing and discounting, complex commit and ramp terms, and the approvals that go with them. You'll make those deals faster to close and cleaner to book, and you'll be the point where regional nuance meets a consistent global standard rather than fragmenting away from it.

You'll partner closely with the global Deal Desk lead to keep one operating model across regions, while adapting it to the realities of selling in markets with different currencies, tax and entity structures, and buying norms. Internally you'll work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, Revenue Operations, Revenue Accounting, Legal, and Finance — translating between what the field needs to win and what the business needs to book cleanly. When those interests pull in different directions, you're often the person who resolves it.

This is a foundational role: you'll establish how Deal Desk operates across our international regions, and you'll hire, develop, and scale the team that runs it. If you want to build the commercial engine for a business growing this fast, in the regions where much of that growth is still ahead of us, this is the seat.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Deal Desk for Anthropic's international business across EMEA and APAC — the operating model, the team, and the outcomes
  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of three, and scale it as the international business grows
  • Serve as the commercial partner to international sales teams on complex and non-standard deals, including pricing, discounting, multi-year and consumption structures, commit and ramp terms, and deal structuring
  • Own the deal approval and review process for the region — clear thresholds, fast turnaround, and the right escalation paths — so that speed and pricing discipline aren't traded off against

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Engine DataModel team, you will own and innovate on the foundational components that form the backbone of the Roblox platform. In the Roblox Engine, the DataModel is a tree-like structure that is analogous to a scenegraph in other 3D engines. This role will report to the engineering manager and will be based out of our HQ in San Mateo, CA in a hybrid model 3 days a week (Tuesdays to Thursdays).

Our team owns:

  • The core structures and systems are used to build the DataModel and interact with it.
  • The C++ reflection bindings that form the Engine’s Luau API surface and let creators interact with the DataModel. We’ve built custom codegen tooling to generate the C++ for these reflection bindings and other related structures.
  • DataModel serialization … and much more!

You will:

  • Develop engine code that performs well for all user-created games on the Roblox platform.
  • Build the core systems and data structures used in the Roblox engine, working with other teams to find universal solutions.
  • Take ownership of projects throughout their full lifecycles.
  • Execute code that performs well on all the devices Roblox supports—from desktop clients to mobile phone clients to console clients.

You have:

  • Have experience working on game engine internals
  • Responsibility for building and maintaining systems that work optimally.
  • Curiosity to learn and stay up-to-date on technology developments.
  • Have a curiosity about the actual work the CPU does when you use smart pointers, templates, virtual functions, and blocks of memory, both structured and raw.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Canada to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centres are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbour, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

  • Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

  • Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement</

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. jobs.title: New Product Introduction (NPI) Sourcing Manager, Data Center Power & Cooling
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI compute at a scale and pace that outruns what off-the-shelf data center equipment was designed for. Much of the power and cooling equipment behind our next campuses — battery energy storage systems (BESS), grid-forming and grid-following inverters, solid-state transformers (SST), E-STATCOM and other power-quality devices, medium-voltage switchgear, UPS, and liquid-cooling systems — is either new to the market, new to the supplier, or being built at a volume the supplier has never shipped before.

The NPI Engineer owns the path from "the supplier has a design" to "the equipment is qualified, manufacturable at rate, and running reliably on site." You sit between our electrical and mechanical design teams, our supply chain and quality teams, and the supplier's engineering and factory organizations, and you make sure every new product or major variant clears the gates — EVT, DVT, PVT, FAT, SAT — before it is trusted with production load. This is a hands-on role: you will spend real time on supplier factory floors, in test labs, and at site commissioning.

What you'll do

  • Own the NPI program for each new power or cooling product (BESS, inverters, SST, E-STATCOM, MV switchgear, UPS, CDUs, chillers) from concept selection through ramp, including the gate schedule, exit criteria, and risk register.

  • Drive early supplier design engagement: translate our site requirements (fault current, grid interconnection, harmonic and ride-through requirements, thermal envelopes, footprint, serviceability) into product requirements and specifications the supplier can build to, and negotiate trade-offs with their engineering teams.

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer - UK
jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Abhik  , Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

jobs.title: Product & Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

Feature conceptualization . Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.

Requirements engineering . Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.

Sprint operations . Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.

UAT, QA and testing . Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.

Analytics and performance measurement . Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.

Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.

Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.

Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast

Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI

Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.

Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.

Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Agile/Scrum

jobs.title: [AI Frontier Div.] AI Native Full Stack Engineer (7년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤의 핵심 AI 기술 역량을 실질적인 사업 성과로 연결하는 실행 중심 조직입니다.
In-game AI, Production AI, LLM AI 등 6개 Squad가 각각의 사업을 빠르게 실험하고 스케일업합니다.
우리가 찾는 AI Native Engineer는 AI를 단순한 보조 도구가 아닌 핵심 개발 파트너로 활용하면서, 동시에 대규모 트래픽 환경에서 서비스를 안정적으로 설계·운영한 경험을 갖춘 시니어 엔지니어입니다.
AI 기술이 빠르게 변화하는 만큼, 새로운 모델과 도구를 누구보다 빨리 습득하고 프로덕션에 적용하는 것도 중요하지만, 그 기술을 안정적이고 확장 가능한 서비스로 만들어 고객에게 전달하는 것이 궁극적인 목표입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • Squad(사업 실행 단위) 소속으로 PO와 함께 AI 기반 제품의 기획·개발·배포·운영 전 과정을 책임
  • AI 모델을 활용한 서비스 기능 설계 및 구현 (프롬프트 설계, API 통합, RAG 파이프라인, MCP 연동, 에이전트 오케스트레이션 등)
  • 프론트엔드와 백엔드를 아우르는 End-to-End 서비스 개발 및 운영
  • 모델 추론(Inference) 파이프라인 구축, 최적화 및 안정적 운영을 위한 모니터링 시스템 개발
  • 대규모 트래픽 환경에서의 서비스 아키텍처 설계 및 성능 최적화

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON에서는 게임을 이해하고 플레이할 수 있는 AI, 플레이어와 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 AI를 만들기 위해 LM, RL, 멀티모달, TTS 등 다양한 영역에서 원천 기술을 연구하고 있습니다.
단순한 기술 연구에 그치지 않고, 이를 실제 게임과 사업으로 연결하는 것이 AI Frontier 본부의 역할입니다.

GX Frontier는 그 최전선에 있는 스쿼드입니다. 크래프톤 및 외부 게임 스튜디오와 협업하여 실제 게임 프로젝트에 AI를 적용하고, 유저에게 새로운 재미와 경험을 만들어냅니다.
CPC 등 KRAFTON AI의 기술 자산을 출발점으로 삼되 이에 국한되지 않고, 게임별 맞춤형 AI 솔루션을 발굴·검증합니다.
PO, BD, 엔지니어가 배치되어 프로젝트를 수행하며, 반복 프로젝트를 통해 내부 공통 모듈을 쌓고 장기적으로는 외부 판매까지 연결하는 구조 — 이른바 '게임 AI의 팔란티어' 모델을 지향합니다.

  • In-game AI 기능의 기획 및 프로젝트 로드맵 수립, End-to-End 실행 총괄
  • AI Engineer, AI Researcher와 협업하여 게임별 맞춤형 AI 솔루션 설계 및 개발 리드
  • 게임 내 AI 기능에 대한 유저 가치 검증 (PoC/Pilot 설계·운영·분석)
  • 프로젝트 성과 데이터 기반 제품 고도화 및 반복 가능한 모듈화 방향 도출
  • 내부 공통 모듈의 사업화 가능성 평가 및 외부 판매 전략 수립 기여

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

Foundation Model Evaluation 팀은 우리 파운데이션 모델과 글로벌 프론티어 LLM을 다각도로 진단하여, 모델 개발의 방향성을 데이터에 기반해 제시하는 역할을 합니다. 벤치마크는 측정 축이 다양하고 점수만으로는 모델의 실질 역량을 판별하기 어렵기 때문에, 우리는 모델이 실제로 어디서 강하고 약한지를 깊이 있게 분석하고 그 결과를 모델 개선으로 연결하는 평가 체계를 구축합니다.

글로벌 프론티어가 주목하는 표준 벤치마크와 실제 사용 맥락을 반영한 자체 평가셋을 함께 운영하며 모델 동향을 추적합니다.

평가 결과를 모델·데이터팀과 공유하여 기술 로드맵과 데이터 전략 수립에 직접 기여합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

Foundation Model Evaluation 팀의 Engineer로서 하게 될 일은 다음과 같습니다:

  • 우리 모델이 집중해야 할 역량과 타겟을 정의하여 모델 개발 전체의 방향성을 제시합니다.
  • 데이터 contamination에 영향을 받지 않고 모델의 실질 역량을 측정할 수 있는 신규 벤치마크를 설계·구축합니다.
  • 프론티어 모델과 우리 모델을 진단하여, 새로운 모델이 등장할 때 적합성을 빠르게 판단하고 기술 의사결정을 지원합니다.
  • 데이터·모델팀과 긴밀히 협업하여 데이터의 약점과 모델 설계의 개선점을 도출·전달합니다.
  • 대규모 평가를 안정적으로 실행·관리하는 평가 파이프라인·플랫폼을 개발하고, 평가 결과와 인사이트를 중앙화합니다.
  • 연구 성과를 Tech Report 또는 NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등 탑티어 학회에 논문·워크숍 형태로 발표합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 딥러닝 관련 분야 전공 석/박사 졸업 이상 혹은 이에 준하는 연구 경력
  • AI 모델 평가·분석 또는 ML/NLP 토픽으로 AI/ML 탑티어 학회(NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등) 논문 작성을 경험하신 분
  • 데이터를 하나하나 들여다보며 인사이트를 도출하는 집중력을 갖추신 분
  • 복잡한 실험 설정, 결과 분석을 명확하게 문서화하고 공유할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 능력을 갖추신 분
  • 새로운 domain에 빠르게 적응할 수 있는 분
  • 원활하게 업무 커뮤니케이션 하실 수 있는 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • AI/ML 탑티어 학회(NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등) 발표/수상 경험이 있으신 분
  • AI 모델 평가를 위한 데이터 수집

KRAFTON MLSys & Ops 팀은 AI Research 본부 내 모델 개발을 위한 GPU 인프라를 설계·구축·운영합니다.
모델 학습 및 실험 환경, GPU 클러스터 운영, 인프라 자동화와 관측성 체계를 함께 다루며, AI 워크로드가 안정적이고 효율적으로 동작할 수 있도록 공통 플랫폼을 만들어갑니다.
이번 포지션은 이미 확보된 B300 125노드 기반 GPU Infrastructure를 함께 운영·고도화하면서, 이를 연구·개발 조직이 안정적이고 효율적으로 활용할 수 있는 GPU Platform으로 발전시키는 실무형 시니어 엔지니어 역할입니다.

  • Kubernetes 기반 ML/GPU Platform의 스케줄링, 멀티테넌시, 워크로드 격리, Quota, 관측성, 장애 대응 체계를 설계·구축·운영합니다.
  • 학습 및 추론 워크로드 특성을 바탕으로 GPU 활용률, 대기 시간, 처리량, 비용 효율을 개선하는 운영 전략을 수립하고 실제 플랫폼에 반영합니다.
  • ML Platform과 재현 가능한 운영 체계를 지속적으로 고도화하고, 여러 연구·개발 조직의 요구사항을 공통 플랫폼 관점에서 조율합니다.</

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여 임직원들의 일하는 방식(Work & Workflow)을 혁신하는 핵심 조직입니다.

AXD FDE(Forward Deployed Engineer) 팀은 전통적인 개발 조직처럼 백오피스에 머물지 않습니다. 현업(게임 제작 스튜디오, 글로벌 퍼블리싱, 백오피스 등)의 한가운데로 직접 투입되어, 그들이 겪는 치명적인 비즈니스 Pain Point를 발굴하고 AI 기술을 통해 즉각적인 솔루션을 만들어냅니다. 전사 AI 해커톤을 이끌고, 최단 시간 내에 MVP(최소 기능 제품)를 런칭하여 '기술이 어떻게 재무적/시간적 성과로 이어지는지'를 현장에서 직접 증명해 낼 강인하고 속도감 있는 FDE 팀을 모십니다.

  • AI 기술 도입 타당성 연구 및 ROI 분석: 도입된 AI 기술의 실제 비용 절감 및 업무 시간 단축 효과를 정량적으로 분석·연구하고, 성공 사례를 전사 스케일업(Scale-up) 전략으로 기획

jobs.title: [Art Dept.] 모션캡처 촬영/데이터 작업자 (신입 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

[Motion Capture Part]

Motion Capture 팀은 KRAFTON Art Department 산하 조직으로, 애니메이션 프로덕션의 제작 효율과 품질을 고도화하는 역할을 수행합니다.
광학 방식의 모션캡처 시스템(VICON)을 기반으로, 게임 개발의 핵심이 되는 고품질 모션 데이터를 제작·제공하는 전문 조직입니다.
신체 및 오브젝트에 마커를 부착하고 적외선 카메라를 통해 움직임을 정밀하게 캡처함으로써, 현실감 높은 캐릭터 모션의 기반 데이터를 생성하여 개발팀에 제공합니다.
또한 단순한 촬영을 넘어, 개발 요구에 맞는 소품 제작 및 촬영 환경 세팅 등 전 과정을 지원하며, 프로젝트 전반에 걸쳐 긴밀한 협업을 통해 최적의 결과물을 도출합니다.
현재 10개 이상의 크래프톤 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다.
모션캡처 기술에 대한 전문성과 열정을 바탕으로 다양한 게임 개발에 기여하고자 하는 분들의 많은 관심과 지원을 기다립니다.

[Art Department 소개]

Art Department는 크래프톤 게임 스튜디오의 아트 프로덕션 전반에 필요한 그래픽 기술과 솔루션을 지원하는 조직입니다.
그래픽 기술과 제작 파이프라인을 기반으로, 게임 개발팀이 빠르고 안정적으로 프로젝트를 시작하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원하며, 크래프톤만의 차별화된 아트 기술 서비스를 제공합니다.
Art Dept는 “Scale-up the Creative”와 “AI-first”라는 회사 방향성 아래, 장인정신에 기반한 높은 퀄리티, 데이터 기반 최적화, 그리고 제작 효율화를 핵심 가치로 삼고 있습니다.
조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다.
단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다.
크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 모션캡처 촬영
    • 촬영 전 액터 셋팅, 캘리브레이션 등 사전 셋팅 작업과 필요 소품을

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

Brand Planning Team은 KRAFTON의 차별적인 가치를 담은 기업 정체성과 브랜드 체계를 수립하고, 글로벌 고객의 인지와 지지를 이끌어냄으로써 브랜드 경쟁력 확대와 사업 성장에 기여를 목표합니다. 사업 전략과 브랜드의 교차점에서 일하며, KRAFTON이 모든 시장·접점·이해관계자에게 자신을 표현하는 방식의 방향을 설정합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

1. 기업 브랜드 전략 수립

  • KRAFTON의 중장기 사업 전략과 연계된 기업 브랜드 방향성, 포지셔닝, 핵심 메시지 체계 수립 지원
  • 글로벌 브랜드 경쟁력을 고려한 전략 아젠다 도출 및 실행 로드맵 수립 참여
  • 브랜드 전략 및 커뮤니케이션 관련 전사 정책·기준 수립 기여

2. 글로벌 브랜드 경쟁력 관리

  • 글로벌 게임·엔터테인먼트 산업 내 브랜드 및 커뮤니케이션 트렌드 분석 및 연구
  • 주요 경쟁사 및 선도 기업의 브랜드 전략 분석을 통한 차별화 기회 도출
  • 타겟 시장 및 고객 세그먼트 기반 브랜드 인식·수용도 분석을 통한 전략 수립
  • Western, Emerging 등 주요 게임 시장에서 KRAFTON 브랜드 경쟁력 강화 방안 연구

3. 브랜드 내재화 전략 수립 및 실행

  • Vision & Values를 포함한 기업 브랜드 체계의 조직 내 정렬을 위한 전략 수립 참여
  • 투자·기획·개발·라이브 등 콘텐츠 Value Chain 전반에 브랜드 정체성을 반영

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 글로벌 회사에서 사업·브랜드·마케팅 전략 기획 최소 3년 이상
  • 게임·엔터테인먼트·테크 산업 내 브랜드 전략 경험
  • 다양한 글로벌 이해관계자와의 협업 경험
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 전략 컨설팅 회사 근무 경험
  • Native 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션 능력

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사

jobs.title: [HR Div.] Developer Relations Program 운영/지원 (3년 미만 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON은 각기 다른 크리에이티브 아이덴티티와 강점을 가진 약 20개 이상의 글로벌 스튜디오로 구성되어 있으며, 국내에만 14개의 스튜디오가 존재합니다. 다양한 위치에서 다양한 프로젝트를 진행하고 있지만, 우리는 모두 하나의 KRAFTON Family입니다.

KDC (KRAFTON Developers Connect)는 KRAFTON Family가 하나로 모일 수 있는 장으로, 서로 다른 배경과 경험을 가진 사람들이 교류하며 창의성(Creativity)을 더욱 발전시킬 수 있다고 믿습니다.

2011년 전사 차원의 지식 공유와 기술 교류를 목적으로 시작된 KDC는 지난 15년간 유관 업계 종사자, 전 세계 스튜디오 및 파트너들과 지속적으로 교류하며 범 크래프톤 차원의 연결을 확장해 왔습니다. KDC 팀은 KRAFTON의 다양한 신작 개발 및 독립 스튜디오 간의 '연결'을 통해 상호 이해를 증진시키고, 개발자 간 지식과 경험이 활발하게 유통될 수 있도록 커뮤니티를 설계하고 운영하는 역할을 합니다.

이를 위해 KDC 팀은 세미나, 핸즈온 워크숍, 해커톤, 직군별 밋업 등 다양한 형식의 프로그램을 기획·운영합니다. 단순히 보고 듣는 것을 넘어 경험을 공유하고, 인사이트를 얻으며, 의미 있는 네트워크를 형성할 수 있도록 — '인정 → 자극 → 동기부여 → 성장 → 새로운 기회'로 이어지는 크래프톤만의 선순환 개발 문화를 만들어가는 것이 우리의 목표입니다.

[지원 전 하기 내용 참고 부탁드립니다.]

  • 본 포지션은 주 3일 근무를 기본으로 합니다.
  • 해커톤 등 주요 행사 기간에는 프로그램 운영 일정에 따라 연장근로 및 야간근로 (밤 10시 ~ 익일 6시)가 발생할 수 있습니다.
  • 행사 운영을 위해 용인 캠퍼스 출장이 발생합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

jobs.title: [Studio Support Div.] Partner Relationship Manager (5~10년 / 계약직)
jobs.description:

With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

External Development Team은 크래프톤 본사 관점에서 외부 개발 업무를 총괄합니다. 주요 역할은 크래프톤 산하 각 스튜디오가 최고의 게임을 만들 수 있도록 적합한 아웃소싱 및 공동 개발(codev) 파트너를 찾을 수 있도록 지원하는 것입니다. 이를 위해 스튜디오와 긴밀히 소통하여 니즈를 파악하고, 다양한 외부 벤더와의 관계를 구축·유지하며, 스튜디오가 파트너와 효과적으로 협업할 수 있도록 가이드를 제공합니다. 저희 팀은 번거로운 업무 프로세스보다는 효율성, 개인의 기여, 그리고 자율성을 중시하는 소규모 팀입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

파트너 관계 매니저는 스튜디오가 협업하고 있거나 잠재적으로 협업할 수 있는 외부 벤더와의 관계를 관리/유지하는 역할을 담당합니다. 주요 업무는 다음과 같습니다:

  • 특정 프로젝트 니즈에 부합한 파트너를 발굴하고 게임 제작팀에게 추천
  • 정기적인 온/오프라인 커뮤니케이션 및 미팅을 통해 파트너와의 관계 구축 및 유지

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a smart, technically strong, and process-adaptive Senior QA Engineer to join our Royal Lounge Casino team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

With 30M+ downloads, Grand Casino is home to slots, bingo, cards, and more! Team members are distributed across the globe with hubs in Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Barcelona, among others

What You’ll Do

  • Write, maintain, and execute test cases for studio games across mobile and web platforms, covering a broad range of devices, operating systems, and browsers.
  • Perform functional and non-functional testing of mobile applications, including network traffic, API responses, and log analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with Scrum teams, Producers, Developers, and QA Leads/Managers to ensure releases meet high quality standards.
  • Communicate proactively with Developers and business stakeholders during defect triage to reduce defect ageing and drive timely resolution.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for defects and provide corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Work effectively in an Agile environment to support timely and high-quality product delivery.
  • Identify quality trade-offs, project risks, and appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Develop a detailed understanding of studio games, including gameplay flows, player journeys, edge cases, and game-specific scenarios.
  • Create and maintain QA documentation, including test cases, test plans, test reports, training material, and process documentation.
  • Mentor junior QA team members and support their technical and domain growth.
  • Partner with the QA Lead to continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and release quality.
  • Support team coordination and delivery in the absence of the QA Lead.

What We Are Looking For

  • 4–7 years of experience in software testing, preferably across mobile, web, or gaming products.
  • Strong familiarity with mobile and web platforms from a QA perspective.
  • Good understanding of client-server architecture, APIs, application data flow, and network debugging.
  • Hands-on experience in test design, test execution, defect reporting, regression testing, and risk-based testing.
  • Strong exploratory testing skills, with the ability to select the right test approach based on feature complexity and risk.
  • Experience using QA tools such as Jira, TestRail, Charles Proxy, Fiddler, browser developer tools, or similar

jobs.title: Senior User Experience Designer - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:

In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

职位概述

我们正在寻找资深游戏交互设计师，作为核心交互设计师，你不只是界面原型产出者，更是全项目玩家体验体系搭建者。核心使命是以游戏世界观为基底，搭建适配的标准化交互管线，统一全系统信息架构、操作逻辑；通过可用性验证、风险前置降低玩家学习成本，打通策划、美术、程序协作壁垒，让游戏获得市面上顶级作品的交互体验。

核心职责

  • 【交互体系搭建】主导项目全链路交互标准制定，设计核心系统信息架构与操作逻辑，沉淀可复用交互组件库，保障全产品体验统一。
  • 【玩家体验验证】搭建玩家可用性测试流程，基于行为数据、玩家反馈识别操作卡顿、信息过载、引导缺失等体验风险，输出可落地迭代方案并跟进落地。
  • 【跨职能流程优化】联动策划、场景美术、客户端程序对齐交互实现边界，梳理原型、评审、落地验收标准化流程，减少反复改稿与沟通内耗。
  • 【团队能力赋能】沉淀交互设计方法论，组织组内评审与经验分享，指导初级交互设计师，统一团队设计思考逻辑与输出标准。

任职要求

  • 从业年限：7 年以上游戏交互 / UX 设计经验，至少 3 年手游完整项目交互负责经验。
  • 项目经历：拥有游戏从零到一完整研发上线经验，能独立搭建整套产品交互框架、组件规范。
  • 专业能力：精通用户体验设计方法论，熟练输出流程图、用户旅程、交互原型、落地规范；熟练 Figma/Axure/Unity，懂界面动效、引擎实现基础限制。
  • 协作能力：熟悉敏捷研发流程，可独立组织跨部门需求评审、原型验收，具备强逻辑拆解与多方对齐能力。

加分项

  • 深度游玩拳头相关游戏产品，熟悉相关世界观和角色设定，可以将IP 特质融入交互表达。
  • 英语流利，可独立阅读英文需求、撰写英文交互规范，适配国际化协作。
  • 完整从研发到上线全流程交互落地经验。
  • 具备用户可用性测试、玩家调研、数据复盘完整实操经验。
  • 有跨国、多区域版本交互适配项目经验。

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
jobs.description:
As a Senior Revenue Accountant, you’ll be in charge of certain areas of the game revenue accounting at Riot Games. This involves critical accounting player life estimates, big data transaction reconciliation and automation for micropayments, devising structure to address controls and risks including for accounts receivable, and thoughtfully developing the technical accounting for emerging revenue issues. To be successful, you’ll need to be flexible working at both a review level and a hands-on detailed level. You will drive projects forward and collaborate with other teams including Finance, Game teams, Payments, Legal, Data, and accounting teams in our global offices.

This position reports to the Accounting Director and will play a key leadership role in the overall Accounting organization around change management, improving processes and controls, scaling accounting, company infrastructure and operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Deeply understand Riot’s statistical player life estimate calculation and work with a data analyst to maintain it. This includes doing analysis to explain changes, working on audit deliverables, and understanding how this estimate would apply to new products.
  • Reconcile large sales datasets with engineering team across the order to cash process. This data would include information from international payment processors with unique fees, FX, and taxes.
  • Further develop processes and automation with the engineering team to increase efficiency and scope of the large data reconciliation noted above. This includes project management, understanding system data flows, and cross team collaboration.
  • Research and formalize technical accounting including Principal vs Agent, Point in Time vs Over Time, Costs to obtain a contract, and Consideration payable to a customer.
  • Review draft contracts to ensure smooth technical accounting.
  • Build out approaches and systems to address key risks such as receivables collectability and chargebacks monitoring.
  • Project manage and oversee certain day to day, period end close, and audit related activities
  • Implement improved approaches to internal revenue data and systems. This may include implementing a more sophisticated revenue system and the related processes
  • Mentor team staff
  • Manage relationships with external auditors to ensure timely completion of annual audits and reviews

Required Qualifications:

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Hardware Platform Security
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Platform Security Engineering (PSE) sits within Data Center Security Engineering (DCSE). As Anthropic expands beyond traditional cloud providers into owned facilities, colocation, and partner sites, we take on the security responsibilities that cloud providers used to abstract away: firmware integrity, boot chain verification, platform trust, and host hardening. PSE exists so that Anthropic can deploy training and inference workloads to any qualified environment with a demonstrable security posture, including the technical controls behind our AI Safety Level commitments.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead a group of platform security engineers covering firmware research, OS and kernel hardening, platform trust integration, and server manageability firmware. You will own the roadmap for this group, grow the team, and be accountable for the security posture of the compute platforms Anthropic runs on: hardware roots of trust, secure and measured boot, attestation, firmware supply chain, and the integrity of the hosts that hold model weights on bare-metal infrastructure.

This is a hands-on management role. You will not write most of the code, but you will review designs, make the final call on hard trade-offs, and be able to reason with your engineers from a silicon root of trust through firmware, bootloader, kernel, and host software. You will partner with infrastructure, fleet, and compute teams inside Anthropic, and with silicon vendors, OEMs, and compute providers outside it.

You will report to the Data Center Security Engineering manager.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and grow the platform security engineering group: hiring, onboarding, development, performance, and prioritization for full-time engineers, and coordination of contractor and vendor engineers working alongside them

  • Own the platform security roadmap and its delivery: hardware root of trust and attestation, secure and measured boot across CPU, BMC, accelerator, and peripheral firmware, OS and kernel hardening, and the host-side pipeline that turns attestation evidence into production gates

  • Own the firmware supply chain posture for the fleet: SBOM and reference integrity manifests, authenticated update, rollback protection, and the vendor relationships needed to get fixes shipped

  • Drive platform risk assessments for new compute platforms and providers, and make evidence-based go/no-go recommendations with bounded risk rather

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic operates and is building data center campuses around the world, run day to day through operating partners, site vendors, and contracted security services. Things go wrong at those sites the way they go wrong at any critical infrastructure: access issues, contractor incidents, protests, weather, equipment failures, and occasionally something with the potential for global impact. Today, what counts as an incident, who gets told, and how it is reported vary by site and by vendor.

As Lead for Crisis and Incident Management, you will build the program that removes that variance, and you will build it with the people who have to live with it. The first job is definition: working with operating partners, site security vendors, managed-service providers, and internal teams to agree on what counts as a minor escalation versus a major incident of global impact, the severity levels in between, the thresholds that move an event from one level to the next, and who gets told, how fast, and in what format. The second job is adoption: turning those definitions into playbooks, training, and exercises so that responders at every site and vendor actually respond the right way, and running the after-action reviews that show where they did not. The third job is measurement: defining the incident metrics, building the reporting, and giving leadership a regular, accurate picture of how response is performing across the fleet. Underneath all three sits the cross-functional work of getting partners to buy in, because a framework no partner has signed up to is a document, not a program.

Continuous coverage is part of the picture. As the program matures, you will shape a 24/7 monitoring and response capability through GSOC-type managed services and site vendors, so that the framework holds at three in the morning at any site in the fleet. That build-out follows from the definitions and partner agreements above rather than replacing them. When a major incident does happen, you run it: activation, coordination, leadership communication, stand-down, and the after-action review that makes the program better.

This is a program-building role, not a shift-supervision role. The deliverable is a framework that partners have adopted, that works at any site, and that reports on itself, run largely through vendors and managed services rather than a large in-house team. Where existing processes and vendor arrangements don't support that, you will have the authority, and the expectation, to change them.

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused development leads to exceptional games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. Since then, Riot has expanded its portfolio and studios globally, continuing to create games that inspire and connect players around the world.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer, Compliance & Release - Wild Rift
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

At Riot, we believe Quality is a set of values, practices, and behaviors that inform every part of the development process. By honing our craft of quality and demonstrating cross-discipline partnerships, we help Riot sustainably craft excellent experiences for players, globally.

QA Engineers are champions for quality, focused on testing to ensure best in practice . We create test plans and evaluate both the functional and subjective caliber of projects for a Riot development team. As every project is different, we listen and improve, to put the players and their team first, and to solve ambiguous and complex problems. Most importantly, it's our passion and love for quality that ensures that QA Engineers help us level up and improve our processes, giving players the best experiences while playing our games.

You’ll collaborate across teams to define testing standards, coach others on execution, and act as a key stakeholder for release quality. This role is pivotal in protecting player trust, and will challenge you to think globally, systemically, and strategically.

To reinforce Riot’s collaborative culture in our China offices, we’ve decided to do away with the constraints of traditional hierarchical title structures that are more common in the region. We believe that removing this constraint will promote individual autonomy, ownership, collaboration, and a focus on results. We promise you won’t need a title at Riot to make an impact.

Platform and infrastructure engineers at Riot build the foundational systems that enable teams to develop, deploy, and operate systems at global scale. They partner across disciplines with other engineers, data scientists, designers, and product teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure underpins every ML capability that reaches players.

作为未公开项目的资深技术美术 - 动画方向，你将专注于动画相关的技术方案设计与引擎落地，帮助团队建立稳定、可扩展的动画技术基础。你将与动画、美术指导、设计、工程以及其他技术美术成员紧密合作，将艺术表现目标转化为可执行的技术实现，并持续提升动画内容在引擎中的质量、稳定性与制作效率。你将汇报给技术美术负责人，并在推进动画技术能力建设的同时，兼顾角色绑定系统的长期发展。

工作职责

  • 负责高优先级引擎动画效果的技术方案设计与落地，包括动画状态机、IK、角色物理及相关动画技术能力建设
  • 跨团队紧密协作，将动作表现、镜头需求及视觉目标转化为可执行的技术方案，并持续提升动画内容的整体表现质量与制作标准。
  • 识别并解决实时动画及动画资产制作过程中的关键技术问题，推进引擎内实现、联调与优化，持续改进动画资产规格，提升落地效率与实现稳定性
  • 搭建、维护并优化角色、生物、道具以及表演相关需求的绑定与动画技术方案
  • 开发和推动面向动画制作与效率工具、调试流程方案，帮助团队更高质量、更高效率地完成内容实现

能力要求

  • 6 年及以上游戏或相关行业技术美术经验，并在技术动画方向有扎实的实操经验
  • 具备从效果目标出发，进行技术抽象与方案判断的能力，能够在动画表现、玩法需求、实现成本与长期可维护性之间做出合理权衡
  • 具备扎实的 Unreal Engine 经验，熟悉蓝图、动画状态机、IK 工作流、角色物理、镜头相关等实现
  • 熟悉 Maya 绑定工作流程与相关功能使用，理解角色绑定与动画系统的基础实现逻辑
  • 优秀的跨职能沟通与协作能力

优先条件

  • 熟悉英雄联盟IP
  • 有主导角色绑定系统开发的经验，或具备基于 Maya 的 Python 脚本开发能力
  • 熟悉风格化角色或变形角色的绑定方案与实现方式
  • 有影视叙事、表演类高规格角色制作流程的相关经验

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Ashby builds software that lets talent teams build an efficient, delightful, respectful hiring process. Similarly, you’re an engineer who wants to build a “paved road” that excellent engineering teams can safely take to the moon and back.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we're hiring for this role .

We’ve listed this role twice: as a Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer – our team does both, and we are open to candidates who lean towards one or the other.

About the role and how we work

Hi  I’m

Colin  , Head of EMEA Engineering. I’ve spent a number of years leading engineering teams in startups, and that has always included being close to infrastructure teams - no matter what name they’ve worn (SRE, infrastructure, platform, etc). I’ve got my hands dirty building the initial infrastructure for startups and know the value a talented infrastructure engineer brings. The rigour, the discipline, the peace and quiet when everything just  hums along .

Our infrastructure is in a good place  for now . Nothing is static. Ashby continues to grow rapidly, putting strain on our existing infrastructure. We don’t put roadblocks to ensure security when common sense will do and we don’t build processes like change management boards around the lowest common denominator. As we grow, more and bigger customers rely on us to be reliable and secure and how we operate internally will need to evolve.

We’re at an inflection point where our ability to scale and deliver a seamless experience has a make-or-break impact – we have some of the fastest growing companies using our platform every day to hire hundreds of people per month. jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Abhik  , Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.

I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.

Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.

jobs.title: Brand Design Lead
jobs.description:
Nash powers the logistics infrastructure behind some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, along with platforms like Shopify and Toast. As we scale, our brand needs to scale with us. We're hiring our first dedicated Brand Designer to craft, shape, and build the visual identity of the platform that is becoming foundational to modern commerce.

The Role

We are right in the middle of defining and rolling out a new Nash brand. Strategy, visual language, motion system, photography direction, the wordmark, the website, the pitch, the booth, the apparel: all of it is being built right now. This is a rare moment to author a brand from close to zero and watch it become the visual identity of a category.

You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (who spent their career building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work alongside our CEO, our CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving cross-functional group across product, engineering, and growth. The bar for taste, craft, and strategic thinking on this team is high, and the trajectory for someone strong in this seat is significant.

How We Work: A.I.-Native, By Default

Brand design at Nash is A.I.-native. We are looking for a designer who has fundamentally rewired how they work around A.I., not a designer who occasionally uses ChatGPT for copy or the occasional inspo image. A designer who reaches for Claude, Cursor, Figma Make, Midjourney, and Runway as instinctively as they reach for the pen tool. Whose entire workflow is built around using A.I. to get to better outcomes faster.

The reason is straightforward: the speed and surface area of what one designer can ship has changed by an order of magnitude in the last eighteen months. We want someone who feels that in their bones and uses it to compound their craft, not replace it.

Don't get us wrong...we  deeply  value the soul, the personality, the whimsy...the  magic  that can only come from a real designer. This is not an A.I. slop-house! But we need to pair the magic of the human touch with the pace and velocity that A.I. tools bring.

In practice, this looks like going from a verbal idea to a working interactive prototype the same afternoon, generating ten directions for a campaign before lunch and using your own taste to pick the one worth refining, prototyping a marketing site section in code with Claude or Cursor and handing a working artifact to engineering instead of a static comp, and treating prompt craft, model choice, and tool-chaining as part of your design practice.

If your reaction to a new A.I. tool is curiosity and a Saturday afternoon experiment, you'll fit here. If you believe that A.I. will never replace ... then you probably won't.

What You'll Do

- Translate, Define and Evolve the new Nash brand strategy into a complete, living visual system: identity applications, motion principles, photogra

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Claude has had commercial impact, but there’s significantly more that frontier AI can do outside of general use cases. Some of the largest opportunities: a step change in health, education, and economic opportunity for the people and institutions the technology would otherwise reach last, sit outside general-purpose use cases. As the Product Manager for Beneficial Deployments within Anthropic Labs, that's your job. You will own two things: the 0-to-1 moonshot bets that could provide a step change in abundance, and the programs that get Claude into the hands of the organizations already working on these problems.

Anthropic Labs runs ambitious product experiments. The team does 0-to-1 product development, taking our most advanced research and turning it into new product categories like Claude Code and MCP. Beneficial Deployments is Anthropic's effort to make sure the benefits of frontier AI reach the people and institutions the market would otherwise reach last: nonprofits, public agencies, and other mission-driven organizations.

We are looking for someone who has founded something, worked inside a civic institution or beneficial organization, and shipped inside a large technology company, with the ability to identify and ultimately define entirely new product categories enabled by AI.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Anthropic's RL Data Platform team builds the systems that produce, move, and serve the human data Claude learns from: the interfaces humans use to give feedback, the pipelines that turn raw feedback into training signal, and the tooling researchers use to launch, monitor, and inspect data collection. Every RL run depends on a steady supply of high-quality data - human feedback, expert demonstrations, graded transcripts - and when a researcher has an idea for new data on Monday, our job is to make it collectable by Wednesday and in the training mix by Friday.

This is a full-stack, ownership-heavy role on a small, senior team. You'll design and ship web interfaces used by thousands of expert annotators, build the backend services and data pipelines behind them, and work directly with RL researchers to understand what data they need and why. You'll scope your own projects, make architectural calls, and see them through to production. We're looking for engineers who treat researchers as their users, build for reliability first, and care as much about the shape of the data leaving the system as the UI going into it.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the feedback and data collection interfaces used by human annotators, domain experts, and internal researchers.

  • Build and maintain the backend services, APIs, and pipelines that route model samples to humans and return structured feedback to training.

  • Own the reliability, latency, and usability of systems that run continuously against live model endpoints.

  • Partner with RL researchers to translate loosely specified data needs into well-scoped collection campaigns and the tooling to run them.

  • Build dashboards, monitoring, and inspection tools so researchers can see data quality and throughput without asking an engineer.

  • Identify and remove the bottlenecks between "we want this data" and "it's in the training mix".

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong full-stack engineering skills, with production experience in TypeScript/React on the frontend and Python on the backend.

  • Experience designing and operating backend services and data pipelines that other teams depend on.

  • A track record of owning projects end-to-end, from an ambiguous brief to something in production that people use.

jobs.title: Chinese Simplified Accessibility Tester
jobs.description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

About the Role

Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents.

You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in the target language.

This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally.

Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system.

What You Will Do

The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below.

Language Validation : Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations.

In-Language Screen Reader Testing : Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud.

Multimedia Accessibility Review : Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language.

Defect Reporting : Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed.

What We Are Looking For

Required

Native or near-native fluency in  Chinese Simplified ; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable.

Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT.

Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549.

Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language.

Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale.

Nice to have

Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications.

Experience with PDF accessibility testing usi

Seobility has been empowering the SEO scene with its all-in-one software, helping website owners and marketers worldwide boost their website rankings. Starting off in 2013 with a small but formidable team, Seobility now has over 800,000 users and earned international awards along the way!

Profile Overview

We're looking for a hands-on Head of Marketing to lead Seobility's next growth chapter, owning our go-to-market and product-led-growth strategy, and building durable growth beyond our Google-organic base.

You will lead a small, talented in-house team with access to further strategic and execution support from saas.group's central marketing team, with further expertise across disciplines like SEO.

You will take full ownership of how we grow MRR, build our brand presence, and take our product to our existing and new users.

This is a rare opportunity to step into a product with deep market credibility and 800,000+ users and have a real impact on its next growth chapter.  Your immediate impact in the first 3–6 months will be:

Audit the current marketing stack, channels, and budget allocation and present a prioritised plan to grow organic traffic sources beyond our strong Google presence.

Establish yourself as a trusted leader for the team, with working rhythms and clear ownership across the function.

Launch at least one new growth channel or partnership initiative that opens up a sustainable traffic or acquisition source.

Lead and develop a team of 2–3 mostly senior marketers — strategic direction, coaching, clear priorities, and planning that keeps delivery on track.

Think marketing AI-native, with tools, automations, and agentic workflows at the heart of research, production and shipping, as well as communication with our users.

Build ecosystem partnerships that expand Seobility's reach and brand authority.

Champion Seobility's presence in the SEO community, thought leadership, and creator/channel strategy ideally including video content.

Generalist growth marketing background: you connect the dots across channels and data, find creative angles, and make things happen without waiting for perfect conditions.

Cresta is on a mission to turn every customer conversation into a competitive advantage by unlocking the true potential of the contact center. Our platform combines the best of AI and human intelligence to help contact centers discover customer insights and behavioral best practices, automate conversations and inefficient processes, and empower every team member to work smarter and faster. Born from the prestigious Stanford AI lab, Cresta's co-founder and chairman is  Sebastian Thrun , the genius behind Google X, Waymo, Udacity, and more. Our leadership also includes CEO,  Ping Wu , the co-founder of Google Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platform,  & co-founder, Tim Shi , an early member of Open AI.  We’ve assembled a world-class team of AI and ML experts, go-to-market leaders, and top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners, Sequoia, and former AT&T CEO John Donovan. Our valued customers include brands like Intuit, Cox Communications, Hilton, and Carmax and we’ve been recognized by Forbes and Bain Consulting as one of the top private AI companies in the world.  Join us on this thrilling journey to revolutionize the workforce with AI. The future of work is here, and it's at Cresta.

About the Role

As the  Founding Conversational Designe r for EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how Cresta delivers conversational AI solutions across the region. You’ll lead the design and deployment of best-in-class AI conversation models that power real-time coaching and assistance for contact center agents, as well as virtual agents across voice and chat experiences.  This is a highly strategic, customer-facing role that combines conversational design expertise with strong project ownership and regional influence. As one of the first hires focused on Conversation Design in EMEA, you will help establish delivery best practices, scale customer impact, and serve as a key partner in expanding Cresta’s presence across international markets.  You will manage complex AI delivery engagements from initial discovery through deployment and optimization, ensuring projects stay on track, stakeholders remain aligned, and outcomes drive measurable business value.  You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, Product, Project Management, and Customer Success, while acting as a trusted advisor to customers throughout implementation. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ANALYTICS

What We Do

Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to support the meta-progression systems area. You’ll apply mixed methods to own the end-to-end life cycle of creating data assets, reports, insights, to impact the direction of efforts across Epic’s portfolio of products and ecosystems, with a particular focus on our meta-progression systems, like XP and Quests. The successful candidate will have the ability to apply a range of data technologies, statistical methods, and visualization methods to influence development and product teams, and to partner with stakeholders across all parts of the business.

In this role, you will

  • Partner with progression and quest product managers and designers to identify opportunities for our meta-progression systems and use data to develop metrics and insights
  • Scope the telemetry these systems depend on and build the ETL, data models, and dashboards stakeholders rely on to tune XP, quests, and the Battle Pass each season
  • Run exploratory analysis, whether that's how to cohort players, what's behind an engagement shift, or funnel analysis
  • Design and run experiments: A/B tests where we can randomize, and other causal inference methods (difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity) where we can't
  • Partner on new progression features from the start, from scoping what to measure through standing up reporting for launch

What we're looking for

  • At least 5 years in analytics or data science, with a proven interest in and knowledge of live-service games and how players engage with them
  • Strong product sense, and a track record of shaping what a team builds by putting the right data in front of the right people
  • Fluent, efficient SQL over very large datasets and solid footing in the Python analytics stack
  • Experience scoping telemetry with programming teams and building the ETL and data models on top of it
  • Grounding in experimental desi

jobs.title: Junior/Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer to build the systems that treat infrastructure as software. This role owns the software state machines that provision hardware, bring it into service, and manage its full lifecycle — turning racks of GPUs into running inference clusters without a human touching a runbook. The Research and Inference team is your customer: today they file tickets and wait; the target state is that they issue a single API call to stand up, scale, or tear down a cluster, and the system takes care of the rest. The platform is manifest-driven such that teams declare the desired state of a cluster or host — shape, topology, software stack — and the system is responsible for reconciling reality to that manifest, continuously, through every stage of its lifecycle. You will design the engines that manifest the schema, the engines that execute against it, and the workflows that carry a piece of hardware or a cluster from one state to the next—taking it from bare metal to a fully functioning AI cluster for training or inference.

You'll write production code which is typed, tested, versioned, and deployed through CI/CD that models infrastructure state and reconciles it, the same way a Kubernetes controller reconciles a cluster's desired state. Success looks like eliminating manual provisioning work, not documenting it better.

A product mindset - you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.You build it, you own it. You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Responsibilities

  • Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
  • Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
  • Automate self-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
  • Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.
  • Partner with the inference/ML platform team: understand the cluster shapes they need — topology, interconnect, scheduling constraints — and encode them as first-class abstractions in the platform.
  • Engineer it like software: strong typing, automated tests,

Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations, including the U.S. Department of War (DoW), its constituent services, and the broader U.S. National Security industry. The Product Manager, Public Sector will lead Scale's product efforts across two connected focus areas — military planning and real-time AI and Alerting (LUX) — shaping real production outcomes and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

This is not a roadmap PM, a CSM, or a solutions engineer. This PM owns product outcomes for a cross-cutting portfolio of AI and data capabilities: earning deep trust with senior military, civilian, and mission stakeholders, driving deployments to production inside classified and operationally constrained environments, identifying where the product is the bottleneck vs. execution, and feeding durable, specific signal back to Scale's platform team. The best candidates have shipped AI or real-time data products into defense or other large, security-constrained organizations and can tell the difference between a customer's stated request, their actual problem, and what the platform should do.

What You'll Do

  • Own product outcomes across Scale's military planning portfolio and/or its highest-impact national security accounts for LUX, spanning multiple DoW and National Security stakeholders and use cases. You are the accountable PM for product delivery and customer value.
  • Translate operational reality into high-signal product input for engineering and platform teams — specific, evidence-backed product perspective with tradeoffs articulated, not requirements docs. jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Research Engineer  in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.  This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.  You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.

You will be expected to move fast, run multiple hypotheses in parallel, identify signal early, and focus on outcomes rather than exploration for its own sake.

Strong experience training deep learning models at scale

Strong Python and PyTorch skills

Experience with large scale multi-GPU / multi-node training

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. Anthropic’s Data Center team is responsible for delivering that physical infrastructure — partnering with build partners, equipment manufacturers, and vendors to stand up facilities that can reliably cool some of the largest accelerator clusters in the industry.

As a Senior Data Center Mechanical Engineer based in the United States, you’ll lead the design direction and technical oversight of building mechanical systems — cooling, chilled-water distribution, liquid cooling, plumbing, and fire protection — across our rapidly expanding U.S. portfolio. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on driving and reviewing mechanical design from concept through detailed design and construction documentation produced by external engineering firms and development partners, ensuring every facility meets Anthropic’s standards for reliability, efficiency, and scalability. You’ll own the mechanical design direction from Basis of Design through construction and commissioning, serving as the primary technical interface between Anthropic’s internal teams and our external engineering and development partners.

A central part of this role is speed-to-capacity through prefabrication and modular construction — modular cooling skids, prefabricated piping assemblies, and design for offsite manufacture that compress schedules and reduce onsite labor. You’ll bring deep familiarity with U.S. mechanical, plumbing, and fire codes and the local regulatory environment, and ensure the cooling architecture keeps pace with rapidly increasing rack densities and the shift toward direct-to-chip liquid cooling. Strong candidates will bring deep mission-critical mechanical design experience and the judgment to make sound trade-offs when the standard playbook doesn’t apply.

Responsibilities

Design direction & review

  • Drive mechanical design concepts for data center cooling plants, chilled-water distribution, liquid cooling (direct-to-chip and CDUs), plumbing, and fire protection systems.

  • Review and direct design drawings, specifications, and construction documentation produced by external engineering firms, ensuring alignment with Anthropic’s Basis of Design and owner requirements.

  • Evaluate design submittals, shop drawings, and equipment selections;

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer - Americas
jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Abhik  , Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

    • Maintain the single source of truth for OFE status across the portfolio — a live tracker of every line item, its milestone dates, and its risk rating.

    Supplier execution

Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Workforce Accounting to join Anthropic's Corporate Accounting Operations team. You will own every number tied to how we pay, equip and reward the people who work here: payroll and accrued compensation, stock-based compensation benefits and relocation, commissions, contingent workers, and travel and expense. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Accounting, you will lead a team of accountants while staying hands-on; reviewing close materials, owning your own accounts, and serving as the first escalation point for the judgment calls in your domain.

Workforce is one of the fastest-moving areas of our P&L. This is a build role: you will write the policies and SOPs your team operates against, design the controls, shape the system integrations, and use Claude and other tools to automate the work that does not need to be manual. We are looking for someone who has built accounting infrastructure in high-growth environments before and wants to do it again at one of the most important companies in the world.

Close ownership
